evidence.scope: The Antifragile Floor v4 hook source at the exact reviewed revision: the afterInitialize precommit binding, the mandatory quadrant-dependent Programmable volume-fee accrual, the self-funded monotonic price floor, and the executed-basis reserve top-up on exact-input sells.

Stateful invariant suite over fuzzed swap sequences: the hook ERC-6909 quote balance equals reserveQuote plus programmableFeeOwed, the reserve is never reduced below its accrued level, and there is no cross-pool netting.

The single-use atomic launcher source: it deploys the token and hook as CREATE2 children, initialises the canonical dynamic-fee pool, seeds one full-range position, and returns residual balances to the launch wallet.
The exact builder submission model used to recompute the mandatory Programmable volume-fee projection, the derived hook permission mask, and the four-quadrant fee-collection paths.

The fixed-supply ERC-20 token source minted once to the launcher in its constructor, with no owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, or upgrade path, so the floor's supply snapshot equals the live supply forever.

The mandatory-fee unit suite: the fixed 10-bps platform basis across all four swap quadrants, executed-not-requested basis, owner-only claim authorisation, no cross-pool netting, and solvency reconciliation.
